title: Decided or Open? Comparing Program Repair Techniques When Patch Correctness Is Unknown
abstract: arXiv:2611.23287v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Comparisons of automated program repair (APR) techniques depend on knowing which patches are correct, but many patches are never checked and some archived test results are wrong. We propose reporting each comparison as decided or open. For two techniques that each pick one patch per bug, we compute the full range of the difference in their success rates over every possible value of the unknown labels, and we call the comparison decided when that range excludes zero. Because a test can only show that a patch is wrong, more testing can move this range in one direction only. This lets us tell, before any test runs, which open comparisons testing could never settle. We study eight settings, including 55,466 candidate patches for Defects4J bugs. The labels already in the archive decide 12 of 16 comparisons between a learned patch selector and its baselines, and adding further evidence decides all 16. In a campaign whose predictions we publish

translated_title: 已判定还是悬而未决？当补丁正确性未知时比较程序修复技术
translated_abstract: 自动程序修复（APR）技术的比较依赖于知道哪些补丁是正确的，但许多补丁从未被检查过，而且一些存档的测试结果是错误的。我们提出将每次比较报告为“已判定”或“悬而未决”。对于各自为每个缺陷选择一个补丁的两种技术，我们计算它们成功率之差在未知标签所有可能取值下的完整范围，当该范围不包含零时，我们称该比较为“已判定”。由于测试只能证明补丁是错误的，更多的测试只能将这个范围朝单一方向移动。这使我们在任何测试运行之前就能判断哪些悬而未决的比较是测试永远无法解决的。我们研究了八种设置，包括针对Defects4J缺陷的55,466个候选补丁。存档中已有的标签判定了学习型补丁选择器与其基线之间16次比较中的12次，而添加进一步的证据后16次比较全部得到判定。在我们发布预测结果的评估活动中……
tldr: 该论文提出一种将程序修复技术比较结果划分为“已判定”或“悬而未决”的方法，通过计算成功率差异在未知补丁正确性标签所有可能取值下的范围来量化比较结论的确定性，并能在测试运行前判断哪些比较无法通过增加测试来解决。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes reporting APR technique comparisons as "decided" or "open" by computing the full range of success-rate differences over all possible unknown patch labels, allowing researchers to determine before any test runs which comparisons can never be settled by additional testing.
